answer: Locks are entered in forge, expire in dune, and prism lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 195 aliases therefore needs 51 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 516 identities would post 2532 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
